sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the respective parties.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences u/s 376(2)(f)/376(3) of the IPC and Sections 4/ 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years along with a fine of Rs.
20,000/- for the offence u/s 4 of the POCSO Act.
It has been alleged that the appellant had committed rape upon his own daughter which had led to her getting pregnant.
PW-2 is the victim of the case who has fully supported the prosecution case.
Although it has been submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that the evidence of PW-2 and PW-3 reveals several contradictions, but the consistency in the evidence of PW-2 categorically reveals about the grossly immoral act which has been committed by the appellant being the father upon his daughter which led to her becoming pregnant and on such consideration, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the appellant is hereby rejected.
